preconditions.description: The input integer x is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The product of a and b is greater than x.
The quotient of a divided by b is less than x.
Both a and b are within the range from 1 to x, inclusive.
b is a divisor of a.

postconditions.expression: not (exists (a, b | 1 <= a <= x and 1 <= b <= x and b divides a and a * b > x and a // b < x))
postconditions.description: If no pair of integers a and b satisfy the conditions, the output is '-1'.
